infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Borongan RoadWatch requires access to the camera to capture photographic evidence of routine road damage.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Borongan RoadWatch uses smartphone GPS hardware to pinpoint the geographical coordinates of reported road hazards in Borongan City.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Borongan RoadWatch requires access to the photo library to upload existing photos of road defects.
